t: A pocket AI learning board with a screen, camera, microphones, and sensors.
steps: Buy a UNIHIKER K10 from DFRobot or a maker store for about 29 US dollars.
Plug it into a computer or USB charger with the included USB-C cable.
Press the A and B buttons to try the built-in face and voice demos.
Install the free Mind+ app on your computer.
Pick the UNIHIKER K10 board in Mind+ and connect it.
Try a first block program that shows the temperature on the screen.
Move on to MicroPython in Thonny. Save your program to the board as main.py to keep it after a restart.
meta: Open Board. From $28.90. A few stores.
